reason: SpellContext gains direct_damage_result, a typed DamageInstructionResult carrying what the immediately preceding damage instruction did (CR 608.2c + CR 614.9): Dealt { recipient }, the object its damage was actually dealt to, read by a slotless 'if a [type] is dealt damage this way' rider (Marauding Raptor); or AwaitingDelivery { sources }, marking a rider parked behind a damage instruction that paused for a replacement choice (CR 616.1) before dealing damage, whose result is published when the rider resumes. It is serialized inside ResolvedAbility, omitted when absent and defaulted when missing, so an older peer reading a resolution paused between the damage and its rider drops the result and suppresses the rider.
